name: Narisokonai Snow White
original_name: なりそこないスノーホワイト
source:
Once upon a time in a country called Engelland, there lived a slightly selfish and narcissistic but still very beautiful little princess.

"Hey Estelio, who's the fairest of them all?"

"Why, Princess, that would be yourself."

The princess was much beloved for being the most beautiful girl in the country, but one day her father remarried, and her new stepsister Nocsia was even more beautiful than she, and with a much more agreeable personality--

"H-hey Estelio, who's the fairest of them all...?"

"Why, Princess, that would be..."

This is the story of a slightly selfish princess and her manservant, a boy as brutally honest as a mirror.

(from official website)
translation:
从前，在一个名叫英格兰的国家里，住着一位有些任性、自恋，却依然美丽无比的小公主。

“喂，埃斯特利奥，谁是世界上最美的人？”

“当然是您自己，公主殿下。”

这位公主因为是全国最美的女孩而深受爱戴。然而有一天，她的父亲再婚了，而新来的妹妹诺西亚不仅比她更加美丽，性格也更加讨人喜欢——

“等、等一下，埃斯特利奥，谁是世界上最美的人……？”

“当然是……”

这是一个有些任性的公主，以及一名诚实得像镜子一样残酷的男仆的故事。

（来自官方网站）
